# Non-volatile Storage NVS

# Copyright (c) 2018 Laczen
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

config NVS
	bool "Non-volatile Storage"
	depends on FLASH
	select CRC
	help
	  Enable tracks of non-volatile storage.

if NVS

config NVS_LOOKUP_CACHE
	bool "Non-volatile Storage lookup cache"
	help
	  Enable Non-volatile Storage cache, used to reduce the NVS data lookup
	  time. Each cache entry holds an address of the most recent allocation
	  table entry (ATE) for all NVS IDs that fall into that cache position.
	  It is recommended to ensure that NVS_LOOKUP_CACHE_SIZE is at least
	  equal to the number of different NVS IDs that will be stored in
	  the NVS.

config NVS_LOOKUP_CACHE_SIZE
	int "Non-volatile Storage lookup cache size"
	default 128
	range 1 65536
	depends on NVS_LOOKUP_CACHE
	help
	  Number of entries in Non-volatile Storage lookup cache.
	  It is recommended that it is a power of 2.

config NVS_DATA_CRC
	bool "Use CRC-32 on the data part of each NVS entry"
	help
	  Add a CRC-32 to the data part of each NVS entry (additional 4 bytes
	  will be stored at the end of the data field of NVS entry) to detect
	  possible corruption of the entry data.

config NVS_INIT_BAD_MEMORY_REGION
	bool "Initialize NVS if memory region appears corrupted"
	help
	  When enabled, if no GC-done marker is found in the NVS region
	  during initialization, the region will be erased and re-initialized.
	  Otherwise, initialization will fail with an error.

module = NVS
module-str = nvs
source "subsys/logging/Kconfig.template.log_config"

endif # NVS
